answer: Sybil resistance here comes from escalating stamp difficulty per identity. Each epoch draws a walnut-seeded challenge, and every answer carries work bound to that identity's nonce. One honest node pays one cheap stamp; a farm must pay it for every key, since work cannot be merged, recycled across epochs, or traded. To grow even a modest grove of puppets an attacker burns fresh electricity each round with no guaranteed reward, and each extra fake node costs more than it can extract. No trusted referee is needed: a sonnet of fakes simply runs at a loss.
